item.title: Matt Damon’s Recent Rap Debut Was for Charity, Not a Career Pivot: ‘Kendrick Has Nothing to Worry About’
item.description:
[Intro music plays]
Host: Welcome to our podcast, where we bring you the latest news and updates from the world of entertainment. Today, we're talking about a unique collaboration between actor Matt Damon and Grammy-winning producer Hit-Boy. Damon has taken on a new persona, "The Nomad," to promote Water.org's new "Get Blue" initiative.
[Short music transition]
Host: In a recent clip posted on Instagram, Damon debuts his rap skills, seeking advice from Hit-Boy on how to make a difference. But Hit-Boy has some funny questions for Damon, like "Isn't 'Nomad' just 'Damon' spelled backwards?" Despite the humor, Damon is serious about promoting the Get Blue campaign, which aims to bring clean water to those who need it most.
[Short music transition]
Host: Damon spoke with Billboard about the campaign, saying "We're always looking for ways to cut through all the noise, and sometimes, humor is a shortcut to get people's attention." He also revealed that his kids are musically inclined, with Taylor Swift being a huge influence in their household.
[Short music transition]
Host: But don't expect Damon to release any official music anytime soon. He joked that Kendrick Lamar has nothing to worry about, and that his rap attempt will just live on social media. The Get Blue campaign is partnering with brands like Gap, Starbucks, and Amazon to launch products that give back. For every purchase, these brands will make a donation to Water.org.
[Short music transition]
Host: You can check out the Get Blue products on Gap's website, Amazon's storefront, or by purchasing specialty drinks at Starbucks. Amazon will also be launching a dedicated Get Blue playlist and REDISCOVER playlists, with a donation made to Water.org every time someone plays a participating artist's playlist.
[Outro music plays]
Host: That's all for today. Thanks for tuning in! If you want to learn more about the Get Blue initiative and how you can help, check out the links in our show notes. Don't forget to follow us for more updates from the world of entertainment.
